- Contact: Alice Rao (alice@nimbus-analytics.com)
- Estimated ARR: $420k

Subject: Re: New referral - Nimbus Analytics (US) — please confirm owner within 72h

Thanks for the heads-up. Looping in Karthik to adjudicate owner and run mapping checks. Karthik — quick ask: can you validate whether this maps cleanly to an existing Redwood SFDC account or if it should be claimed under the partner-managed flow? There are sometimes duplicate corporate records (Nimbus Tech vs. Nimbus Analytics) that trigger mis-claims.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) Pull Partner Center export + SFDC account search (please attach the SFDC record links).
2) Apply the ownership priority rules (recent touch, product fit, enterprise coverage).
3) If ambiguous, propose a deconfliction rule and assign interim owner for the 72h window so PC doesn’t auto-assign.

I've attached the partner CSV for quick reference. If Karthik recommends another owner, we can escalate to Laura for final sign-off.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Channel GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: referral_export_20270628.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 19:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: New referral - Nimbus Analytics (US) — mapping notes + conflict

Tessa — I pulled the referral and did an initial SFDC search. Quick notes:
- There are two existing SFDC accounts: "Nimbus Analytics (Corp)" (owned by laura_bennett) and "Nimbus Tech Solutions" (owned by vanessa_ortiz). Both have related opportunities historically.
- The partner contact Alice Rao is tied to Nimbus Analytics (Corp) in our records, but recent quota/workload suggests Vanessa's book was the last active touch for a cross-sell last quarter.

I attached a short ownership_priority_matrix.xlsx that codifies tie-breaks I use:
  1) Partner contact mapping (direct match wins)
  2) Most recent meaningful touch (call/demo/opportunity in last 180 days)
  3) Product fit score (edge-serving inference + compliance needs)
  4) ARR / deal size (higher ARR routes to enterprise seller)

Applying the matrix here: contact maps to Laura, last touch maps to Vanessa. Product fit favors enterprise (Laura), ARR (~$420k) suggests enterprise seller. My recommendation:
- Assign interim ownership to Laura for Partner Center registration to prevent auto-assignment.
- Set a 7-day deconfliction window where Vanessa and Laura can confirm final ownership via the channel queue.
- If still tied after 7 days, escalate to regional head (Tessa) for final decision.

Next steps I propose (short timeline):
- Laura: confirm you can accept interim owner by EOD Tue 29 Jun.
- Vanessa: note any objections with supporting evidence (last-touch artifacts) in the channel thread.
- I will update Partner Center and SFDC owner fields and attach the mutual action plan.

Attachments: ownership_priority_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB), mutual_action_plan_nimbus.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: New referral - Nimbus Analytics (US) — mapping notes + conflict

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the matrix. Short reply: I can defer to Laura for the Partner Center claim if she wants interim ownership, but only under these conditions:
- Partner provides an exec sponsor (VP/Head of Data) for contract conversations.
- CS confirms no active renewal/opportunity in my book that would be impacted.

I'll upload the last-touch call notes to the channel by noon. If there is an active opportunity in my pipeline that conflicts, I'll flag it with deal ids. Otherwise, happy to step back so we can move the referral through.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Sales Manager, Americas
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com, alice@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 20:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: New referral - Nimbus Analytics (US) — owner deconfliction & mapping (final plan)

Laura — thanks for staying in the loop. Per Karthik's matrix and Vanessa's note, here's the consolidated plan and asks:

1) Interim assignment: Laura, please accept interim owner in Partner Center and SFDC by 23:59 UTC Wed 30 Jun so the referral isn't auto-assigned.
2) Deconfliction window: 7 calendar days (through Wed 07 Jul). During this window Vanessa should post any pipeline evidence.
3) Required partner confirmation: Alice — can you please share an exec sponsor and target timeline for procurement? That will help the SEA team route appropriately.
4) Docs & links: HubSpot deal HB-4982 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4982) and our mutual action plan (attached). We'll also prepare a DocuSign once owner is final.

If no objections, I'll mark the referral as "claimed" in Partner Center and kick off the MAP and initial intro with Alice. Laura — please confirm in-thread once you've updated SFDC so we have an audit trail.

Thanks everyone — moving quickly here to respect Partner Center SLA.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Channel GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_nimbus.docx (DOCX, 45KB)
